source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the components of the immune system (PDF 176-177).

blocks.text: Immune system jism mein kisi aik jagah mehdood nahin. Balke yeh bohat se alag alag cells se bana hai jo hamla awar microbes se larne ke liye infection ki jagah daurte hain. Yeh cells white blood cells (safaid khoon ke cells) hain jo bone marrow (haddi ke goode) mein bante hain aur khoon aur lymph mein gardish karte hain. Yeh lymph nodes, spleen (tilli), liver (jigar), thymus aur bone marrow mein bhi milte hain. White blood cells ki teen bari qismein hain: monocytes, T cells aur B cells. T aur B cells ko mila kar lymphocytes kehte hain.

Monocytes WBCs (white blood cells) ki aik qism hain aur doosre white blood cells ki tarah bone marrow mein bante hain. Yeh khoon mein gardish karte hain aur interstitial fluid (cells ke darmiyan ka maya) mein bhi chale jate hain. Wahan yeh pukhta (mature) ho kar macrophages ban jate hain. Macrophages microbes ko phagocytose (nigal) kar ke tabah kar dete hain. Yeh aise proteins bhi banate hain jo helper T cells ko fa'al (activate) karte hain. Monocytes doosri qism ke phagocytes mein bhi badalte hain jo liver, spleen, lymph nodes aur doosre tissues mein rehte hain. Yeh cells ka malba (debris) saaf karne aur tissue ke nuqsan ki marammat mein bhi madad dete hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai ke monocytes lymphoid tissues mein bante hain. Yeh sahi nahin: monocytes, doosre white blood cells ki tarah, bone marrow ke stem cells se bante hain; kitab khud isi topic ke shuru mein kehti hai ke white blood cells bone marrow mein bante hain. Lymphoid tissues (lymph nodes, spleen) mein yeh baad mein pohanch kar kaam karte hain.

blocks.alt: Insani jism ka khaaka jis mein immune system ke aaza: gale mein tonsils aur adenoids, gardan, baghal aur raan ke jor par lymph nodes, inhein jorti lymphatic vessels, seene mein thymus, pet ke baayen taraf tilli (spleen), appendix, aur raan ki haddiyon mein bone marrow.

blocks.text: Doosre white blood cells ki tarah T cells bhi bone marrow ke stem cells se bante hain. Phir yeh thymus mein chale jate hain, jo dil ke bilkul oopar waqe aik chhota sa surmai (grey) gland hai. Wahan yeh pukhta hote hain aur hamla awar microbes par maujood bairooni molecules (antigens) ko pehchanne ki salahiyat hasil karte hain. Karoron (tens of millions) mukhtalif T cells bante hain. Har T cell sirf aik khaas antigen pehchanne ka mahir hota hai. Koi bhi hamla awar kam az kam chand T cells ki pehchan se nahin bach sakta. T cells ki chaar bari qismein hain:

items: Helper T cells, jo immune response shuru karte hain
Cytotoxic T cells, jo microbes se infected cells ko tor dete hain
Inducer T cells, jo thymus mein T cells ki nashonuma ki nigrani karte hain
Suppressor T cells, jo immune response ko khatam karte hain

blocks.text: B cells bhi bone marrow mein bante hain lekin T cells ke bar-aks yeh pukhta hone ke liye thymus nahin jate. Yeh apni pukhtagi bone marrow hi mein mukammal karte hain. Wahan se yeh khoon aur lymph mein gardish ke liye chhor diye jate hain. T cells ki tarah har B cell bhi khaas antigens pehchanne ka mahir hota hai. Jab B cell ka kisi antigen se saamna hota hai to yeh taqseem ho kar bohat se naye cells banata hai jinhein plasma cells kehte hain. Har plasma cell aisi antibody banata hai jo antigen se chipak jati hai aur us par tabahi ka nishan laga deti hai.

blocks.prompt: T cells aur B cells kahan bante aur kahan pukhta hote hain?
blocks.explanation: Dono bone marrow ke stem cells se bante hain. T cells thymus mein ja kar pukhta hote hain; B cells bone marrow hi mein pukhta hote hain.

items: Immune system ke cells white blood cells hain jo bone marrow mein bante aur khoon aur lymph mein gardish karte hain.
Monocytes macrophages aur doosre phagocytes bante hain; helper T cells ko fa'al karne wale proteins banate hain.
T cells thymus mein pukhta: helper, cytotoxic, inducer, suppressor.
B cells bone marrow mein pukhta; antigen milne par plasma cells bante hain jo antibodies banate hain.
